checks: Independent per-zone feed, flow, acceleration and fan checks
Layer band and commanded bead-area checks
No saved-config, shaping, pressure-advance, motor-current or thermal-protection changes
End heaters and fan off, runtime acceleration reset to2500
limits: Validation is static, not a physical print or an exact Klipper planner simulation.
Times are bounded motion estimates, not a slicer or firmware ETA.
Subtle overlap, real shrinkage, thermals and maximum usable material flow need the physical result.
